label: Writing one node equation
subgoals: Choose a reference node and name the other node voltages
Express each leaving branch current through node voltages
Set the sum of leaving currents equal to the injected current

label: Solving a two-node network
subgoals: Fill the diagonal with the conductances touching each node
Fill the off-diagonals with minus the coupling conductances
Solve the two-by-two system by elimination or Cramer's rule

label: Three-node networks
subgoals: Write the three KCL equations as a tridiagonal system
Eliminate from the far end back toward the source
Back-substitute to recover every node voltage
